## Personality

The Twin Sailors are a pair of jolly tars who have traveled extensively. Through their many journeys, they have seen everything in the world.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)_

## History

The Twin Sailors are imaginary characters invented by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) as part of his shore-side fantasy world. Alongside figureheads like [Nora](../character/nora.md) and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) envisions magical adventures with the Twin Sailors, such as sailing into a moonglade to visit the sunset land. However, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) openly acknowledges in his writing that these companions and their journeys are merely fictional creations.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P45](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0045), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P46](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0046), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P46](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0046), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P50](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0050), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P52](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0052), +13 more_

## Relationships

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--twin-sailors.md)

The Twin Sailors are imaginary figures created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), who writes about them coming ashore to converse with him. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) details magical adventures featuring them, such as sailing into a moonglade to visit the sunset land, though he acknowledges in a letter that these companions and their stories are entirely fictional.

- presumed Friend of — imaginary rock people who come ashore to talk with him  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
